name: Mobile devices per mailbox
description: Lists the mobile devices that have synchronised with each mailbox, with access state and, if ticked, the last successful sync; can list only devices not synchronised for a number of days.

parameters.name: Mailbox
parameters.label: Mailboxes
parameters.help: Email addresses or aliases. Leave blank to check every mailbox up to the limit.

parameters.name: IncludeLastSync
parameters.label: Include last sync
parameters.help: Read each device's last successful sync, which needs one extra read per device.

parameters.name: StaleDays
parameters.label: Not synchronised for (days)
parameters.help: Only devices whose last successful sync is at least this many days ago. Devices whose last sync is unknown are kept.

parameters.name: MaxMailboxes
parameters.label: Maximum mailboxes
parameters.help: When no mailbox is named, stops after this many and says the result is partial.

parameters.name: MaxRows
parameters.label: Maximum devices
parameters.help: Stops after this many devices and says the result is partial.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange role that can read recipients and mobile devices.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.
Devices are read once per mailbox, and the last sync once per device, so large tenants take a while.
A device whose last successful sync was not returned is SyncStatus Unknown and is kept by the stale filter.
Intune enrolment and compliance are not read here; IsManaged and IsCompliant are as Exchange reports them.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
